text.mod.description: Unofficial Rock-afire Explosion simulator for Minecraft, mod made by FlooferLand and Monsterwaill!
block.showbiz.speaker: Speaker
tooltip.showbiz.block.staged_bot:
Also known as animatronics/figures
- Right-click to change models
- Place a block on top to hide the block
tooltip.showbiz.block.greybox:
Reads data from a reel-to-reel
and spits out show data
tooltip.showbiz.block.speaker:
Shakes the air violently to produce sound
(currently only mono audio supported)
tooltip.showbiz.block.show_parser:
Turns show bit data into redstone
when hooked up to a Greybox
tooltip.showbiz.block.show_bridge:
Allows you to send data outside of Minecraft
(ex: controlling real animatronics)
tooltip.showbiz.block.show_selector:
Allows people to select a reel to be played
when hooked up to a reel-to-reel
tooltip.showbiz.block.curtain_block:
Place at the top of a stage to droop curtains down.
Connect one of them to a Curtain Controller
Use a dye to change the colour
tooltip.showbiz.block.curtain_controller: Converts bits to curtain control signals
tooltip.showbiz.block.spotlight:
Requires a shader patched with IRLights (J menu).
Read the IRLights documentation
tooltip.showbiz.block.floodlight:
Requires a shader patched with IRLights (J menu).
Read the IRLights documentation
WORK IN PROGRESS
tooltip.showbiz.block.bit_view: Shows bits and their names live when plugged into a show
tooltip.showbiz.block.programmer: Allows you to record in bits
tooltip.showbiz.block.cymbal: Gives Rolfe something to hit (or not)
tooltip.showbiz.item.bot:
Shift right-click to pick it back up
Right click to customize
Work in progress!
